title_zh: 保山市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神
title_en: Baoshan Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets to Study Spirit of Fifth Plenary Session
summary_zh: 2026年11月13日，保山市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神，重温习近平总书记考察云南重要讲话精神。
summary_en: On Nov 13, 2026, the CPC Baoshan Municipal Standing Committee met to study the spirit of the Party's Fifth Plenary Session and to revisit Xi Jinping's remarks during his inspection of Yunnan.
